name: Collateral Amount 17
definition: Provides details on the collateral valuation.

ValueOfCollateralHeld.name: Value Of Collateral Held
ValueOfCollateralHeld.definition: Total value of posted collateral (post-haircut) expressed in the reporting currency.

TotalExposure.name: Total Exposure
TotalExposure.definition: Total exposure amount between the giver and taker expressed in the reporting currency. It includes the transaction amount and the accrued interests minus any  unsettled amount.

TransactionAmount.name: Transaction Amount
TransactionAmount.definition: Transaction Amount as instructed by the client.

TransactionAmountBreakdown.name: Transaction Amount Breakdown
TransactionAmountBreakdown.definition: Breakdown of transaction amount (required value for the exposure)  into market value lots based on  the term for the underlying trades.

Margin.name: Margin
Margin.definition: The difference between the total collateral value and the total collateral required.

TotalAccruedInterest.name: Total Accrued Interest
TotalAccruedInterest.definition: Total amount of money accrued interest computed in the case of interest bearing financial instruments.

TotalCollateralRequired.name: Total Collateral Required
TotalCollateralRequired.definition: Collateral is required to cover interest that accrues on the exposure. Margin amount would thus be the difference between collateral required and collateral value (that is COVA).

TotalValueOfOwnCollateral.name: Total Value Of Own Collateral
TotalValueOfOwnCollateral.definition: Total value of own collateral in the reporting currency.

TotalValueOfReusedCollateral.name: Total Value Of Reused Collateral
TotalValueOfReusedCollateral.definition: Total value of reused/rehypotheticated collateral in the reporting currency.

TotalPendingCollateralIn.name: Total Pending Collateral In
TotalPendingCollateralIn.definition: Value of incoming collateral, to be settled in the reporting currency.

TotalPendingCollateralOut.name: Total Pending Collateral Out
TotalPendingCollateralOut.definition: Value of outgoing collateral, to be settled in the reporting currency.

TotalOfPrincipals.name: Total Of Principals
TotalOfPrincipals.definition: Total of principals in the reporting currency.

TotalCashFailed.name: Total Cash Failed
TotalCashFailed.definition: Total value of undelivered intended transaction cash amount.
